# This Week in AI: The 5 Stories That Matter (November 15, 2026)

Samsung has announced AI-powered smart glasses. "Smart glasses" are regular-looking eyeglasses with a small computer inside, so you can use AI without pulling out your phone. ## 2. Microsoft Has Published Work on Hidden Triggers in AI

Microsoft has published information about hidden-trigger attacks on AI models. A "trigger" is a hidden instruction planted inside a model that can change its behavior when it sees a certain word or image. The model may seem normal until that trigger appears, which makes the risk hard to spot. The specifics of Microsoft's findings are not confirmed in our source, so read its official publication for the full picture.

AI presenter videos use a computer-generated speaker on screen. A new guide covers how these videos can be used, but the specific use cases it lists are not confirmed in our source.
